title: Chickpea Hummus & Veggie Plate
description: Creamy chickpea hummus served with fresh vegetables for a satisfying, nutrient-dense snack.
ingredients: Carrots, peppers and celery to serve
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until smooth.
Serve with cut vegetables for dipping.
notes: Pairing hummus with raw veggies instead of crackers keeps this snack high in fiber and slower to digest.
